topics.title: Gary’s Date Dilemma
topics.summary: Gary attempts to arrange a date with three women, each offering vastly different qualities and interests – heavy metal music/skiing, teeth & money, or Olympic dancing. He ultimately chooses Amanda, a 22-year-old dancer, creating an age gap that is noted by the hosts.

topics.title: Awkward Romance and Political Intrigue
topics.summary: A man recounts an uncomfortable encounter with Amanda, who is attracted to Gary due to his bowling skills. Simultaneously, news reports detail investigations into Vice President Gore’s fundraising activities and potential impeachment proceedings against the president, including a phone call that could lead to legal trouble.

topics.title: Administration Under Investigation
topics.summary: Multiple figures within the administration are being investigated by a Justice Department led by Reno, including potential legal violations related to Gore. The President is reportedly focused on repairing his marriage with Hillary Clinton through gestures like complimenting her appearance and offering cigars – attempts that often lead to awkwardness. Other scandals emerge: a California woman charged for mailing cyanide packets, a judge shocked in court, an investigation into the nude flights of Air National Guard pilots.

topics.title: Stern Fields Fake Phone Call Chaos
topics.summary: During a broadcast, Howard Stern recounts a bizarre incident where he fielded calls from ABC News reporters including Peter Jennings and Judge Edo while discussing an O.J. Simpson situation in Los Angeles. Amidst fabricated details and misinterpretations, he engages in playful banter with the reporters and even contemplates his role within the network, culminating in a humorous exchange about Al Michaels.

topics.title: Al Michaels’ Radio Broadcast & Market Speculation
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Al Michaels discusses cryptic references to Jake and Peter, Nicole Simpson’s phone call, and coded language. The conversation shifts to market fluctuations with the president urging calm amidst investor concerns about Russia and rising stock prices.

topics.title: Stock Market, Impregnation Controversy & Titanic
topics.summary: The broadcast began with discussions about stock market volatility and bond prices, followed by a bizarre segment involving a caller who impregnated his daughter. Financial analysts warned of continued economic uncertainty while the hosts debated the president’s apology regarding Monica Lewinsky. A Utah video store offered to edit adult scenes from *Titanic* for $5, prompting commentary on parental concerns and personal movie viewing habits.
